changes: Removed duplicate page-level headings and generic tenant metadata fallbacks in the preceding release.
Hardened tenant color tokens and deep-page text contrast without changing tenant identity.
Removed nested interactive controls and fixed alert, tag, price, cookie and research-page semantics.
Reduced mobile product image priority to the number visible in each view mode.
Marked category thumbnails decorative when the adjacent category name already supplies the link name.
